Router.title: Router
Router.description: MikroTik router configuration and live telemetry managed by the administrator.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated administrator.

name.description: Friendly name of the MikroTik router.

ip.description: IP address or hostname of the router.

port.description: Port number for RouterOS REST API.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp. Submitted as server timestamp.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. Submitted as server timestamp.

NetworkUser.title: NetworkUser
NetworkUser.description: Monitored client or hotspot subscriber with bandwidth quota constraints.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated administrator.

usedDownloadGb.description: Total download consumed this month in Gigabytes.

usedUploadGb.description: Total upload consumed this month in Gigabytes.

maxDownloadMbps.description: Speed limit for download in Mbps.

maxUploadMbps.description: Speed limit for upload in Mbps.

alertThresholdPercent.description: Threshold percentage to trigger quota warnings.

status.description: Current status (ACTIVE, WARNING, THROTTLED, EXCEEDED, SUSPENDED).

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp. Submitted as server timestamp.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. Submitted as server timestamp.

Alert.title: Alert
Alert.description: Instant quota warning or critical threshold alert.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated administrator.

userName.description: Subscriber name associated with the alert.

message.description: Detailed explanation of the alert event.

isResolved.description: Whether the alert has been acted upon.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp. Submitted as server timestamp.

UserUsage.title: UserUsage
UserUsage.description: Granular session or daily internet usage log for a subscriber.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated administrator.

sessionDurationMinutes.description: Duration of active session in minutes.

peakRateMbps.description: Peak bandwidth speed recorded during the session.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp. Submitted as server timestamp.

/users/{userId}/routers/{routerId}.description: MikroTik routers configured by the administrator.

/users/{userId}/network_users/{networkUs.description: Network subscribers and their quotas monitored by the administrator.

/users/{userId}/alerts/{alertId}.description: Instant quota alerts received by the administrator.

/users/{userId}/usage_logs/{logId}.description: Daily internet consumption logs recorded for subscribers.
